cohort: 319 mothers who gave birth in a hospital and volunteered for the study.
finding: Maternal satisfaction in labor was found to be at a moderate level and is affected by the mode of delivery and other factors, with the method of delivery also having various negative effects on the newborn.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery significantly affected sub-dimensions of the Birth Satisfaction Scale and maternal satisfaction, and the method of delivery was associated with various negative effects on the newborn.
